ops.body: Progress + reconciliation note. The cc-orchestrate half (new `cco agent attach <id>`: optional backend.Attacher interface, tmux/zellij AttachArgv with focus pre-steps, orchestrate/attach.go CLI command over the execve seam, full test coverage) was implemented in this session's shared working tree and then shipped OUT OF BAND by a concurrent session: commit 17bc52f (v0.11.0, subject "walk-based window identity via cc-interact procs") squashed our attach work together with that session's window-identity work — not path-scoped, and the subject does not mention attach. Verified: 17bc52f is on origin/main and all three CI workflows (CI, Guides, cc-notes) are green on it. Not reversible (pushed trunk); treated as the cco ship for this task. The cc-pane half (kill/message/respawn/attach UI: CcoClient POST procedures, overlay state machine, confirm modal, message prompt, x/m/r/t bindings, suspend/spawn/resume attach flow; 129 tests green, typecheck clean, adversarial review clean) is still uncommitted in cc-pane's working tree, pending live e2e before its own path-scoped ship.
